employees.basis: approximately 15,000 people worldwide, including approximately 1,700 dedicated to the Aramids Business

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, the Company employed approximately 15,000 people worldwide, approximately 1,700 of which are dedicated to the Aramids Business.

payroll.label: annual total compensation for the median employee

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The annual total compensation for the median employee was $85,492, determined in the same manner used to calculate total compensation for purposes of the Summary Compensation Table

notes: Employees: approximate count at December 31, 2025, after the Qnity spin-off; it includes about 1,700 people in the Aramids business, which was sold on April 1, 2026. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used (same year as the head count); the median employee was identified from all employees worldwide as of November 2, 2025, using base pay.
